explication: Higgsfield AI Skills is a collection of Markdown-driven agent skills rather than a conventional application server. Agent integrations load skill instructions from the individual `higgsfield-*` directories, then guide users through Higgsfield generation APIs, website tooling, and local creative-production workflows. The documented primary workflow spans media generation, Soul identity training, brand-system creation, product and marketplace imagery, thumbnails, explainers, websites, and games. Skills can chain: Soul training produces a reusable reference ID for generation, while website and brand workflows combine remote assets with deterministic local processing. The sampled Python code shows two substantial local toolchains: Brandkit approval/state and verified brandbook export, plus website-oriented GLB/texture processing and procedural animation. Because most SKILL.md and reference contents were not provided, API command details, game-generation internals, and exact orchestration between agent hosts and remote Higgsfield services are documented at a high level only; unsupported runtime edges are intentionally omitted.
